I don’t think so. I know we’ve kind of gone over that, but I haven’t had a clear two-week period where I was down or hopeless most of the day, or not enjoying most things. It’s more that I get stressed and worn out, but not like that.

Yes, that happens. A common example is if my husband asks me to call the insurance company, upload a form, and then email the confirmation. I’ll usually do the first part, maybe even most of it, but then the last step somehow just sits there unfinished until he reminds me.

It’s not just one area, no. I notice it at work and at home mostly.
